document.name: Cutest Cookies Birthday Parties
document.shortDescription: Cutest Cookies in Staten Island hosts cookie-decorating and hands-on baking birthday parties with explicit weekday and weekend pricing on its official page.
document.longDescription:
Cutest Cookies publishes birthday party packages at 1300 Hylan Blvd in Staten Island. The official page says all parties include invitations, make-your-own pizza, birthday cake, popcorn and drinks, party supplies, aprons, and take-home cookie boxes.

The official page lists a two-hour Cookie Decorating Party priced at $400 for up to 12 children Monday through Thursday, $500 for up to 12 children Friday through Sunday, and $450 on school holidays, with additional per-child fees above the base package. It also lists a Kid's Hands On Baking Party for ages 8 and up at $75 per person, lasting three hours, with a minimum of 6 guests and maximum of 8 guests.

Cutest Cookies states a recommended minimum age of 5 years old and lists contact information as (718) 966-2883 and info@cutestcookies.com. Because the official pricing explicitly separates Monday-Thursday from Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, this listing uses weekday and weekend tags only and does not infer time-of-day availability.

Sources: https://www.cutestcookies.com/pages/parties https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0992/3726/files/FullSizeRender_medium.jpg?v=1498070436
